integrity: The area and fifth-order limit are proved by angular covering and integration; sampled calculations support but do not replace that proof. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the first nontrivial multiplicity transition, for 0<alpha<4 and s>1, is treated. The Gamma spectral-index theorem is invoked as established; no independent verification of that theorem, publication priority or wider alpha regimes is claimed.
title: Quintic birth of the double-Fredholm-index region for Gamma Hausdorff operators
